title: Zesty Creamy Moroccan Lamb Roast
description: A tangy, creamy lamb roast wrapped in corn husks with a shortcrust pastry crust, served warm with a yogurt‑sour cream sauce.

ingredients.name: cream sauce (Greek yogurt 150 g + sour cream 80 g)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and soak four corn husks in warm water for 15 minutes.
Season the 2 kg lamb shoulder with sea salt, black pepper, garlic & ginger blend, spice mix, and lemon juice & zest; let it marinate for 20 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the lamb on all sides until browned, about 8 minutes.
Place the shortcrust pastry sheet over the lamb, sealing the edges with a little water so it stays in place.
Wrap the pot and the wrapped lamb tightly in the soaked corn husks, tying them securely with kitchen twine.
Place the wrapped pot on a baking sheet and bake for 60 minutes, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 63°C.
Remove the pot from the oven, unwrap the husks and pastry, and let the lamb rest for 10 minutes.
Whisk together the cream sauce of Greek yogurt and sour cream until smooth, then drizzle over the sliced lamb.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
